input.quote: (d) Neither party may assign this Agreement or any rights and obligations under this Agreement to any third party without the written consent of the other party.
input.rationale: Section 20(d) is a blanket assignment prohibition with no M&A or affiliate carve-out for Sparkling and no reasonableness standard on consent, and Section 3(c) separately bars Sparkling from assigning except as Garman authorizes in writing. That fails even the fallback (mutual right to assign to successors on written notice, with consent for other assignments not unreasonably withheld) and sits in walk-away territory on the missing M&A carve-out. There is no Garman termination or re-pricing right on a Sparkling change of control, so no deletion is needed there. The redline adds the affiliate/successor carve-out for us, keeps Garman's assignment consent-based (not to a competitor), and applies a reasonableness standard to all other assignments.

proposal.summary: Add affiliate/successor assignment right for Sparkling and a reasonableness standard on consent
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We need the ability to assign to an affiliate or to a successor on a merger or sale of substantially all assets without Garman's consent, and any other assignment consent should not be unreasonably withheld; Garman's assignment remains consent-based and excludes our competitors. We have also conformed Section 3(c) so the use restrictions do not cut across this right.

ops.oldText: (d) Neither party may assign this Agreement or any rights and obligations under this Agreement to any third party without the written consent of the other party.
ops.newText: (d) Sparkling may assign this Agreement and its rights and obligations under this Agreement, without the consent of Garman, to an affiliate or to a successor in connection with a merger, amalgamation, reorganization, acquisition or sale of all or substantially all of its assets or business, upon written notice to Garman. Garman may not assign this Agreement or any rights and obligations under this Agreement without the prior written consent of Sparkling, such consent not to be unreasonably withheld, and in no event to a competitor of Sparkling. Any other assignment by either party requires the prior written consent of the other party, such consent not to be unreasonably withheld.

ops.oldText: (c) not assign this Agreement or transfer, lease, export or grant a sublicence of the Work to any Person, except as and when authorized to do so by Garman in writing;
ops.newText: (c) not transfer, lease, export or grant a sublicence of the Work to any Person, except as and when authorized to do so by Garman in writing, and not assign this Agreement except as permitted by Section 20(d);
